zh.title: 英國法院對越捷航空發布全球資產凍結令
zh.summary: 英國法院凍結越捷航空全球資產，追討逾2.5億美元判決債務
body: 英國商業法院於2026年10月15日對越捷航空（VietJet Aviation）發布全球資產凍結令。FW Aviation Holdings1 Limited（FWA）正尋求追討逾2.5億美元的未清償法院判決款項。法院表示，越捷可能將資產移出債權人可追索範圍，存在相關風險。
爭議涉及四架空中巴士A321飛機的租賃協議，飛機於2018年及2019年交付越捷航空。法院審視的另一項安排涉及越捷與 Angelica Holding Limited（AHL）的協議；越捷將未來飛機訂單簿幾乎全部價值轉給AHL，估值基準為2024年12月。

en.title: UK court grants worldwide asset freeze against VietJet over leasing debt
en.summary: UK court freezes VietJet assets as FW Aviation pursues more than $250 million in judgments
body: The UK Commercial Court granted a worldwide asset-freezing order against VietJet Aviation on 15 October 2026. FW Aviation Holdings1 Limited (FWA) is seeking to recover more than $250 million in outstanding court judgments. The court found a real risk that VietJet could move assets beyond creditors’ reach while FWA continues its recovery efforts.

The dispute concerns lease agreements for four Airbus A321 aircraft delivered to VietJet in 2018 and 2019. The court also examined agreements involving Angelica Holding Limited (AHL), under which VietJet transferred almost all the value of its future aircraft order book to AHL, based on the order book’s value in December 2024.
